resolved_findings: Rewalk all parent directories and leaf after source read.
Read selected source after final native callbacks.
Pin original CAS/store and private inventory identity.
Decode closed binding and host byte limits.
Recompute full source CID for a complete offset-zero reply.
Use Git owner-execute bit instead of any execute permission.
Cap source frames before body receipt.
Require canonical received JSON for actual wire accounting.
Read indexed values of actual DuckDBRow wrappers.

limitations: Sequential source observations, without atomic writer lease.
Whole inventory and selected file are read per slice under the owner lock.
One task binding per gateway lifetime.
Host-issued child transport; coding-model container channel remains unqualified.
Partial slice CID is not a whole-source membership proof.
Context/public path scope is host admitted; proof and omission authorities stay false.
